components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action in a booth step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:48px;padding:14px 24px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--primary,#f6821f);color:var(--primary-foreground,#17191b);font:700 14px/1 'Inter Variable',sans-serif;transition:transform 200ms ease,filter 200ms ease,box-shadow 200ms ease;box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgb(246 130 31 / 20%)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.06)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#f6821f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(0)}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet alternative for retakes and recovery actions.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact operational metadata without dashboard density.

components.name: Scene Card
components.css: .ds-scene{display:grid;gap:8px;min-height:150px;width:280px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border,#ffffff1f);border-radius:18px;background:#27302c;color:#f4f2ed;text-align:left;transition:transform 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease}.ds-scene:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#72c98d}.ds-scene:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#f6821f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-scene-number{font:600 10px/1 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:#72c98d}.ds-scene strong{align-self:end;font:600 17px/1.2 'Inter Variable',sans-serif}.ds-scene small{color:rgb(244 242 237 / 62%);font:400 12px/1.4 'Inter Variable',sans-serif}

components.name: Generation Progress
components.description: Visible creative progress that turns waiting into momentum.

narrative.overview: The interface is a compact creative studio in motion: dark, focused, and precise at rest, then bright and expressive in response to an attendee. It is a kiosk product, not a dashboard; the system hides infrastructure behind a single obvious path.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Cloud Orange occupies less than 12 percent of a screen.

rules.name: The Short Headline Rule
rules.body: Display copy is a visual action cue, not a paragraph.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Ordinary surfaces stay flat; elevation appears only for hierarchy, manipulation, or the final artifact.

dos: Do keep one dominant action per step.
Do keep touch targets at least 44 by 44 pixels.
Do use shadcn/ui primitives before introducing a custom equivalent.
donts: Don't make this resemble a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't rely on orange alone to communicate state.
